messages:
Elaine (CEO): Quick tidecheck for the week — three asks before Friday. 1) Confirm EU private beta capacity (100 rps target). 2) Freeze model-catalog changes for GA candidates. 3) Cost guardrail: -6% unit cost vs our benchmark. TL;DR: close, but need coordinated ops and a clear rollback plan.
Priya (VP Ops): Status update: EU dedicated pools at ~85% of target. Scaling validation scheduled tomorrow 08:00 PST. @Jon can you lead the scale canary and post results?
Jon (SRE): On it. Running a canary scale today AM. If we hit KV cache warmup delays I'll flip the kernel-config tweak I tested yesterday. Will post logs & metrics to #eng-sre.
Maya (Product): About the catalog freeze — we should allow emergency security patches. Proposal: freeze + exception window requiring PR + VP signoff + sec review.
Liam (Finance): Cost target notes — current optimizations show ~-3.5% via batching and cache hits. Need top 5 routes by token spend to prioritize further gains.
Elaine (CEO): Action items: (A) @Jon run scale and post results by 10:30am local, (B) @Priya coordinate canary customers and a rollback play, (C) @Maya publish freeze policy + exception flow by EOD. I'll join Friday 09:00 roll-call to sign off.
deploy-bot: Canary job submitted: job/scale-eu-2198765432 — status: queued.
Jon (SRE): Canary completed — median tail latency 95ms (target 100ms). KV warmup improved: 20s -> 6s after kernel tweak. Logs: https://logs.internal/scale-eu/2198765432 (sensitive).
Priya (VP Ops): Canary customers notified. Draft rollback runbook shared in #release-war-room: fallback to smaller model variant per high-cost route + region fallback policy.
Maya (Product): Freeze policy published: https://docs.internal/model-freeze (internal). Exception flow = PR + VP signoff + security approval; will add a short template for emergency patches.
Liam (Finance): We'll spin up an hourly burn dashboard for next 48h and share read-only links. Ping me if you need edit access.
Elaine (CEO): Thanks team — big win on the latency improvement @Jon :trophy:. We'll reconvene Friday for final GA go/no-go. :thumbsup:
